rows.en: Hey! Pull yourself together!!
But the Maganac's strength gave out.
...Three Gundams? So there are more of them besides Nu Gundam and Zeta?
And on the enemy's side, no less...
I don't want to fight a fellow Gundam, but...
Gundams fighting each other... I don't even want to think about it.
Gundams, huh... Not the kind of opponent I'd want against me.
Gundams, huh... They'd be a real pain to have as enemies.
Gundams, huh... Whatever comes at us, I'll take it down!
Gundams, huh... I hope this is some kind of mistake.
I've met one, y'know? Though that guy was all on his own.
Just like me, he was a guy who was at his climax right from the start!
Nothing you're saying makes any sense.
What'd you say, you bastard!?
Still, I'd rather not fight a fellow Gundam.
But Gundams fighting each other... I'd really rather not think about it.
Gundams, huh... Not the kind of opponent I'd want against me.
Gundams, huh... They'd be troublesome to have as enemies.
Gundams, huh... Whatever comes at us, I'll take it down!
A mobile suit...?
This one... What is this feeling...?
Huh...? Who the hell are you?
...? Do you have some business with us?
...!? Sorry, but could you please get out of the way?
What...? Is it an enemy...?
What's your deal? You got business with us?
The mysterious group attacked without a word!
Did we get them?
Still, those were some odd enemies...
You shouldn't have come out!
But what is this feeling...?
We did it!!
But there was something strange about those enemies...
Nailed it!
...Still, those were some weird enemies.
Phew... We did it...
But those enemies gave me a really bad feeling...
Hell yeah!!
Still, what a bunch of freaks! Those square-eyed bastards!
We did it!
But... those were some strange enemies.
Just then, someone with an unfamiliar voice appeared before the heroes.
So you managed to beat the Leo mobile dolls... Not bad at all.
You bastards! You'll pay for that!
You guys are new faces, huh? Never seen you before.
Three Gundams...!!
Three Gundams...!!
Three Gundams...!!
Three Gundams...!!
Three Gundams...!!
Three Gundams...!!
Three Gundams...!!
Yeah, that's right. We're Team Trinity!
The three-in-one Gundam team!
Now then, who should I take down first~?
Wait. I want to see more of what they can do.
We'll let the Taurus squad handle them.
Whaaat!? Booooring!
Woo-hoo! Now this'll be a show! You beat the Leos, but how'll you do against the Tauruses!?
You'd better keep me entertained!! You do NOT want to make me angry, got it!?

notes.note: Speaker labels in 0205 #0.37-0.55 look shifted against the leader-variant order (e.g. #0.48 labelled Ankh is Momotaros' climax catchphrase, #0.49 labelled Den-O is Ankh's retort, #0.50 labelled Nu Gundam is Momotaros' outburst). Voiced each line from its content, not the label. #0.37/#0.51 read as a Gundam (Zeta or Nu) speaking of fellow Gundams.

Labelled Mebius (also #0.55), but the cocky 'I'll take it down' with ze fits Zero, not polite Mebius; written cocky. #0.42 (no label) is the earnest 'I hope it's a mistake', likely the real Mebius line.
'Chikara tsukita' kept as 'strength gave out' - ambiguous between collapsing and dying; nothing in the next rows settles it.
Ankh says 'Zeta' (short form in katakana), kept as Zeta.
Momotaros (Den-O Sword Form) says he has met a Gundam that was alone; referent not clarified in the slice, kept literal.
Source says 'MS' (abbreviation); expanded to 'mobile suit' for readability. Labelled Zero but almost certainly a Gundam leader's line (Nu Gundam).

Leader-variant rows #0.2-0.8 and #0.15-0.28 have no/unreliable labels; voices inferred from content (#0.3/#0.17/#0.18 Zeta-like Newtype sense, #0.4/#0.25-26 Momotaros, #0.6 OOO's politeness, #0.21 Shotaro).
Kamille-style lament; rendered 'You shouldn't have come out!' rather than a wistful 'if only'.
'Square-eyed' refers to the Leo's visor; Japanese singular 'yarou' rendered plural since several Leos fought.
Leo (mobile doll from Gundam Wing) not in glossary; used the standard English name. Source sets it in brackets; dropped the quotes and kept 'mobile doll' term.
Source writes Team 'Trinity' in brackets; used glossary 'Team Trinity' without quotes.

report: All 80 rows translated. Speaker labels in 0205/0206 leader-variant blocks are unreliable/shifted; voices taken from content. Name not in glossary: Leo (mobile doll). See notes.
